input: i want to manage docker containers
i want to see docker containers
i want to stop a docker container

arguments.command:
termy_say -s "Please choose a docker management option" &&
printf "\r\n1) 🐳 List Running Containers\n2) 🛑 Stop a Container\n3) 📜 View Container Logs\n\nSelect option 1-3: " &&
read -r dock_choice &&
case "$dock_choice" in
 1)
  docker ps &&
  printf "\n" &&
  termy_say -s "Containers listed"
 ;;
 2)
  termy_say -s "Please enter the container name or I D" &&
  printf "Container ID or Name: " &&
  read -r c_name &&
  if [ -n "$c_name" ]; then
   docker stop "$c_name" &&
   printf "\nStopped container \033[1m%s\033[22m.\n" "$c_name" &&
   termy_say -s "Container stopped successfully";
  else
   printf "\n⛔ Selection cannot be empty.\n" &&
   termy_say -s "Operation cancelled";
  fi
 ;;
 3)
  termy_say -s "Please enter the container name or I D" &&
  printf "Container ID or Name: " &&
  read -r c_log &&
  if [ -n "$c_log" ]; then
   docker logs --tail 20 "$c_log" &&
   printf "\n" &&
   termy_say -s "Logs displayed";
  else
   printf "\n⛔ Selection cannot be empty.\n" &&
   termy_say -s "Operation cancelled";
  fi
 ;;
 *)
  printf "\n⛔ Invalid choice.\n" &&
  termy_say -s "Invalid selection"
 ;;
esac
arguments.explanation: Provides a menu for managing Docker containers, allowing the user to list, stop, or view logs of containers.
